defs.def: to a small degree 少许；少量；一点

ex.s: Either way, your apparent missteps will have moved you a little closer to true mastery.
ex.t: 无论哪种情况，你那些明显的失误都会让你离真正的精通更近一点。

ex.s: We were raised on books and computers, highways and cell phones, but now we were living in a village without running water or electricity It was easy for us to go to sleep at the end of the day feeling a little misunderstood.
ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.s: One study in America found that students' grades ___62___ (improve) a little after the school introduced uniforms.
ex.t: 美国一项研究发现，学校引入校服后，学生的成绩___62___（improve）了一点。

ex.s: Benjamin could read only a little,having been a poor student.But he later said,”Those two books were my companions by day,and under my pillow at night.”While it is likely that he understood very little of the books,they were his introduction to classical paintings.The nine-year-old boy decided then that he would be an artist.
ex.t: 本杰明只读过一点书，因为他曾是个差学生。但他后来说：“那两本书白天是我的伙伴，晚上就在我的枕头下。”虽然他很可能几乎看不懂那些书，但它们是他接触古典绘画的入门。这个九岁男孩当时就下定决心要成为一名艺术家。

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意开得稍远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次很棒的周末出游。

ex.s: Does your soul die a little every time you throw away unused food?
ex.t: 每次你扔掉没用过的食物，你的灵魂会不会死掉一点点？

ex.s: Ultimately, success came little by little.
ex.t: 太阳能开发商希望尽快且廉价地安装电池板，所以他们没有过多考虑安装在电池板下面的是什么。

ex.s: Just try a little .
ex.t: 只要稍微试一下。

ex.s: A little self-forgiveness also goes a long way.
ex.t: 一点自我宽恕也大有帮助。

ex.s: They’re all situations where we could use a little extra patience
ex.t: 它们都是我们可能需要多一点耐心的情形。

ex.s: Knowing a little about a lot of things that interest you can add to the richness of a whole, well-lived life.
ex.t: 对自己感兴趣的许多事情略知一二，能为完整而充实的人生增添丰富性。

ex.s: The wise old man told him to travel to the Li River～perhaps he could learn a little from the greatest artist in the world.
ex.t: 那位睿智的老人让他去漓江旅行——也许他能从业界最伟大的画家那里学到一点东西。

ex.s: A son of immigrants, Chris stared learning English a little over three years ago.
ex.t: 作为移民的儿子，克里斯在三年多一点前才开始学习英语。

ex.s: She may just need a little persuading.
ex.t: 她也许只是需要一点劝说。

ex.s: I started doing anything I could to help them build a little （10）     ．Most important， I began to treat them like （11）     ． That summer， when the other teams enjoyed their （12）      ， we met every day and （13）     passing and kicking the football．
ex.t: 我开始尽我所能帮助他们建立一点（10）____。最重要的是，我开始把他们当作（11）____。那年夏天，当其他队伍享受他们的（12）____时，我们每天碰面，并（13）____传接和踢足球。

ex.s: With a little help from his school and the local community centre, Mark used his bricks to build a small bike shelter for his neighbourhood.
ex.t: 在他学校和当地社区中心的一点帮助下,马克用他的砖头为他的邻居建造了一座小型自行车避难所.

ex.s: I bought a handful of perfectly ripe small strawberries and a little sweet melon.
ex.t: 我买了一小把熟透的小草莓和一个甜甜的小甜瓜。
